articles.title: Crypto ally French Hill wins reelection but set to lose House chair
articles.snippet: Republican French Hill secured another term in Congress but will lose his leadership of the House Financial Services Committee when Democrats take control in January.

articles.title: US Voters Back AI Data Center Restrictions in At Least 29 Communities
articles.snippet: Voters across the United States backed measures to curb data centers, raising new obstacles for the infrastructure powering AI as electricity bills, water supplies, and public oversight dominate the debate.
